Offline place names

nexGallery bundles a reduced copy of the GeoNames "cities15000" data set
(city name, country, coordinates rounded to 0.001 degrees and population in
thousands) and the GeoNames country names.

Source: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0),
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The data was converted to a compact tab-separated, gzip-compressed file. No
other changes were made. The data is provided "as is" without warranty of any
kind.
